width.note: Bounding box along X (the main arm length).

depth.note: Bounding box along Z (the return wing length, back edge to front edge).

armDepth.note: Depth of the main arm along the back wall. Always < depth (800 < 1000).

wingWidth.note: Width of the return wing. Always < width (800 < 1200).

orientation.note: Side of the return wing seen from the user (+Z side). The user sits in the notch of the L.

footprintParts: main arm: width x armDepth, against the back edge
return wing: wingWidth x (depth - armDepth), on the orientation side, towards the user

notes: L-shaped desk. Origin = centre of the bounding box (width x depth), back edge at z = -depth/2, user side +Z, like desk.rect, so camera framing and keep-out box are unchanged. orientation 'right' puts the wing at +X, 'left' mirrors it. Top = one extruded L (1 draw call), 6 posts at 60 mm inset from the outer corners, rear and wing-side rails. Label: Corner 160x140 / 180x160 cm.
